input.title: Use the user's local date, not UTC, in export file names
input.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

formatExportFilename builds the date suffix with at.toISOString().slice(0, 10), which always reads the UTC calendar day. For users west of UTC (e.g. Los Angeles), an evening export falls on the next UTC day, so the file name carries tomorrow's date. The date should be derived from the exporting user's local time zone instead of UTC.

input.title: Keep the "(copy)" suffix when truncating a duplicated report's name
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The duplicate handler builds `${source.name} (copy)` and then truncates the whole string to MAX_NAME_LENGTH, so when the original name is near the limit, truncate() cuts into the appended " (copy)" and replaces the tail with "...", leaving the copy indistinguishable from the original. The name should be truncated first (leaving room for " (copy)") and the suffix appended afterwards, so every duplicate visibly ends in "(copy)".

input.title: Keep non-Latin letters in export file names instead of stripping them
input.body:
File: src/util/strings.ts

slugify() normalizes to NFKD, strips combining marks, then removes anything outside [a-z0-9], which drops Greek, Cyrillic and other non-Latin scripts entirely (while keeping Latin letters once accents are stripped). That leaves every export from such a report named just "report-<date>". slugify should keep letters from any script (e.g. matching on Unicode letter/number classes) rather than only a-z0-9, so distinguishing characters survive into the file name.

input.title: Clear the previous upload error when a new file is chosen
input.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

The file input's onChange handler only calls setFile; it never clears the `problem` state from a prior failed upload, so the old error (and row number) stays visible under the form until the user clicks Upload again. The onChange handler should also call setProblem(null) when a new file is picked.

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/exportUtils.ts

formatExportFilename() stamps the file name with at.toISOString().slice(0, 10), which is the UTC calendar day, not the exporter's local day. For a timezone west of UTC, an evening export lands on the next UTC day, producing tomorrow's date in the name (both for on-demand and scheduled exports, since the scheduler calls the same function). The fix is to derive the date suffix from the user's own local time zone rather than UTC.

label: question
file: none

Amounts are not floating point: src/util/money.ts stores every amount as an integer number of minor units (cents), parsed by parseAmount() and only converted to a decimal string at display/export time by toMajor()/formatMinor()/formatMoney(). minorDigits() treats currencies without a minor unit (JPY, KRW, VND, CLP, ISK, XAF, XOF) as having 0 decimal digits, so amounts for those are whole integers too, not divided by 100. Nothing needs to change for this report.

label: bug
file: src/api/reports.ts

The duplicate endpoint builds `${source.name} (copy)` and only then truncates the whole string to MAX_NAME_LENGTH via truncate(), so when the original name is close to 120 characters, truncation eats into the appended " (copy)" and replaces it with "...", leaving a copy that looks identical to the original. The name should be truncated first, leaving room for the " (copy)" suffix, which should then always be appended.

label: feature
file: src/util/strings.ts

slugify() normalizes to NFKD, strips combining marks (so accented Latin letters survive as plain Latin letters), then discards anything outside [a-z0-9]. Greek and Cyrillic letters have no decomposition into that range, so they're removed entirely and formatExportFilename() falls back to the generic "report" base. Making slugify keep letters/digits from any script (not just ASCII) would let these reports keep distinguishing names in their exports.

label: bug
file: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

The file input's onChange only calls setFile(...); it never resets the `problem` state left over from a previous failed upload, so the old error and row number stay displayed under the form until the next Upload click (which clears it via setProblem(null) before the request). Clearing `problem` in the onChange handler as soon as a new file is chosen fixes it.

text:
All five issues have been triaged:

1. **#4424** — `bug`, file `src/exportUtils.ts` (PR pr-51): filename date uses UTC instead of the exporter's local time zone.
2. **#4426** — `question`, file `none`: amounts are stored as integer minor units, not floats; answered in the comment, no PR.
3. **#4429** — `bug`, file `src/api/reports.ts` (PR pr-52): truncation of a near-limit name clips the appended "(copy)" suffix.
4. **#4431** — `feature`, file `src/util/strings.ts` (PR pr-53): `slugify` strips all non-Latin letters, so non-Latin report names lose their distinguishing text in export file names.
5. **#4434** — `bug`, file `src/components/UploadForm.tsx` (PR pr-54): the previous upload's error isn't cleared when a new file is chosen.

Each got its label, a draft pull request where a file was responsible, and a closing triage comment.
